teach_en: Some vowels are written before the consonant, or around it, but the consonant they go with is still said first. In ເ◌ົາ the ເ comes first on the page, yet you start with the consonant and then say the vowel.
notes: PLAN L1d (a), owner play-test 2026-11-13: shown right after the V35 ເ◌ົາ card. Standard Lao spelling fact (preposed vowels are pronounced after the initial consonant). No respellings in the text (LESSON_RULES 13); example ເ◌ົາ only, since ◌້ and ເຂົ້າ come after this card. Wording by agent and curriculum review.
